hero.badge: Introducing the Next Evolution of ERP
hero.description: The global command center for bookkeeping, compliance, and growth. Automate your invoices, reconcile bank feeds, and let AI reveal your financial truth.

features.description: We've automated the boring bits so you can focus on building your empire. No more manual reconciliation or missing tax deadlines.

automatedInvoicing.title: Automated Invoicing

zeroEffortRetainers.title: Zero-Effort Retainers

aiBabaBotInsights.title: AI BabaBot Insights
aiBabaBotInsights.description: Chat with your data. Get instant financial summaries and trend analysis using natural language.

expenseLedger.title: Expense Ledger

investmentHub.title: Investment Hub

globalCompliance.title: Global Compliance

premiumProposals.title: Premium Proposals

inventoryHub.title: Inventory Hub
inventoryHub.description: Track physical assets, raw materials, and finished goods across multiple warehouses.

storeCatalog.title: Integrated Service E-Store

multiChannelNotifications.title: Multi-Channel Notifications
multiChannelNotifications.description: Get real-time alerts via Email, Web Push, and In-App notifications for critical business events.

caCompliance.title: CA Compliance & Audit Ledger

multiLevelRoles.title: Multi-Level Roles

nativeApps.title: Native Android & iOS Apps
